title: introduce-lightprobe: compact on-call diagnostic probe + playbook fusion
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Motivation: on-call responders need a fast, low-noise diagnostic snapshot that fits in a notification card and a single-click playbook chooser. This PR ships 'LightProbe' — a compact telemetry sampler that produces a prioritized diagnostic digest — and the 'playbook fuse' UX that attaches contextual playbook suggestions to the probe. Goals: 1) reduce on-call cognitive load by surfacing 3–5 highest-confidence remediation hints; 2) make playbooks actionable from a single commute (copy/paste-free) step; 3) keep the probe size and collection time bounded (~5s, <256KB payload). Summary of changes: - Implementation of LightProbe sampler (agent library + CLI glue) with deterministic snapshot prioritization and optional anonymization hooks. - Playbook fusion algorithm that ranks candidate playbooks by signal-match score (alert fingerprint × recent telemetry delta × historical success). - New /api/v1/probes endpoint and a PlaybookSuggestion sidebar component used by the oncall UI. - Small UX flow and accessibility tweaks so suggestions are keyboard-navigable and copy-safe. - Backwards-compatible telemetry schema v1.1 (probe.metadata.* added). Compatibility & safety: probe runs at user-trigger or incident-initiated and respects redwood RBAC + scrub rules; default anonymization enabled for external/Slack exports. Performance: local microbenchmark under dev cluster shows median probe generation 3.8s (p95 5.1s) and 180KB median payload. See release notes.
